work.abstract_text: Starting from Blitvić, Kammoun and Steingrímsson's Jacobi-fraction theorem (Part II, arXiv:2611.12829v1, Theorem 9.2, 9 November 2026), we extend their congruence observations in Part I (arXiv:2610.29846v1, Section 7, item 11, p. 49) to finite linear recurrences modulo every integer coprime to six. In particular, the prescribed 14325 packing count is one modulo thirty-five for an odd number of windows and six for an even number. An alternative proof of the original modulo-ten and four-divisibility laws uses Wallner's rank recurrence and Catalan numbers. For prescribed mixtures of overlaps one and two we give product congruences and characterize exactly when the comparison poset has a separator.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore
authors.name: Wenlin Zhang

work.title: Modular recurrences and alternative proofs of Blitvić, Kammoun and Steingrímsson's 14325 packing congruences
